name: Gelato
summary: **Gelato** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by Sherbinski and Jigga in San Francisco around 2014. A cross of [[sunset-sherbet|Sunset Sherbet]] and [[thin-mint-gsc|Thin Mint GSC]], it was selected from roughly 200 seedlings and narrowed to numbered phenotypes. [[gelato-33|Gelato #33]] and [[gelato-41|Gelato #41]] became its best-known cuts.

sources.title: The Sherbinski Sitdown: A Comprehensive Guide to Gelato
